title: comma-ref
tagline: fun challenging mind games platforms. consists of suduku , skyscraper and Futoshiki
description:
this project is centered around classic mind games , currently we have suduku, Futoshiki, and Skyscrapers but we plan to add a lot more, all games utilize zk technology to verify the answer and reward nfts, once the participant collect all the games nft they are able to mint a grand nft to show case how brilliant they are.

IMPORTANT : the NFT minting function doesnt work as of the writing of the this description 6 hours before deadline will continue to investigate
how_its_made: the project mainly uses zksnark to develope a zk smart contract , and its deployed on the  new wallaby testnet, on the frontend it uses nextjs to create all the games , in addition to nftstorage. plans are underway to recreate the nft awarding process to take advantage of all the new stuff that comes with fevm.
